item.name: Berserker
item.summary: A low-health combat enchant that increases damage and can heal you when you are near defeat.
item.cardSummary: Trade health for stronger attacks, then recover health at the low-health trigger.
item.effect: Damage increases as your health falls, and attacks restore health once you reach the low-health trigger.
item.requirements: Repair the broken Enchant Table with 8 Diamonds, then spend 2 Emeralds to roll.
item.restrictions: The Enchant Table is absent in SkyWars, Gun Game, Infected, Lasso Wars, Block Hunt, Arena Duels, and One in the Chamber.

item.name: Critical Strike
item.summary: A damage enchant that gives attacks a chance to land a stronger critical hit.
item.cardSummary: Increase burst damage through chance-based critical hits.
item.effect: Attacks have a chance to deal extra critical damage.
item.effect_details: The current effect reference describes 20% to 45% extra damage on a critical hit.
item.requirements: Repair the broken Enchant Table with 8 Diamonds, then spend 2 Emeralds to roll.
item.restrictions: The Enchant Table is absent in SkyWars, Gun Game, Infected, Lasso Wars, Block Hunt, Arena Duels, and One in the Chamber.

item.name: Execute
item.summary: A finishing enchant that makes weakened enemies vulnerable to an instant-kill effect.
item.cardSummary: Build the execute threshold through attacks and finish low-health enemies.
item.effect: Hits raise the target's execute threshold; an attack that leaves the target below that threshold can finish them immediately.
item.effect_details: The current effect reference describes a 12% base threshold, 2% increases per stack, and an 18% maximum threshold.
item.requirements: Repair the broken Enchant Table with 8 Diamonds, then spend 2 Emeralds to roll.
item.restrictions: The Enchant Table is absent in SkyWars, Gun Game, Infected, Lasso Wars, Block Hunt, Arena Duels, and One in the Chamber.

item.name: Fire
item.summary: A damage-over-time enchant that burns enemies after they are hit.
item.cardSummary: Keep pressure on enemies with burn damage that can build through repeated hits.
item.effect: Attacks apply a burn effect that continues dealing damage after the hit.
item.effect_details: Repeated attacks can build the burn effect up to four stacks.
item.requirements: Repair the broken Enchant Table with 8 Diamonds, then spend 2 Emeralds to roll.
item.restrictions: The Enchant Table is absent in SkyWars, Gun Game, Infected, Lasso Wars, Block Hunt, Arena Duels, and One in the Chamber.

item.name: Forest
item.summary: A sustain enchant that marks enemies and turns attacks into healing and maximum-health growth.
item.cardSummary: Mark enemies, harvest seedlings, and build health while fighting.
item.effect: Marked enemies grow visible seedlings; damaging them restores health and increases your maximum health.
item.effect_details: Seedlings regrow after 45 seconds, and ranged damage reduces the health gained from the effect.
item.requirements: Repair the broken Enchant Table with 8 Diamonds, then spend 2 Emeralds to roll.
item.restrictions: The Enchant Table is absent in SkyWars, Gun Game, Infected, Lasso Wars, Block Hunt, Arena Duels, and One in the Chamber.

item.name: Soul Reaver
item.summary: A kill-streak enchant that summons a damaging aura after you eliminate an enemy.
item.cardSummary: Turn eliminations into a stacking aura that punishes nearby enemies.
item.effect: An aura appears after a kill and deals damage nearby; further stacks increase its size and damage.
item.effect_details: The 2025 patch record increased the aura duration to 7 seconds.
item.requirements: Repair the broken Enchant Table with 8 Diamonds, then spend 2 Emeralds to roll.
item.duration: Until death or replacement; the aura lasts 7 seconds after a kill.
item.restrictions: The Enchant Table is absent in SkyWars, Gun Game, Infected, Lasso Wars, Block Hunt, Arena Duels, and One in the Chamber.

item.name: Static
item.summary: A chain-damage enchant that shocks nearby enemies and weakens their healing.
item.cardSummary: Use chained shock damage and Static Charges to pressure grouped or healing enemies.
item.trigger: Attacking an enemy near other enemies
item.effect: Attacks deal extra static damage, can chain to nearby enemies, apply Zapped, and build Static Charge with melee hits.
item.effect_details: Three Static Charges trigger extra lightning; the current effect reference lists an 8-damage bonus, a 2-second cooldown, and a 6-block radius.
item.requirements: Repair the broken Enchant Table with 8 Diamonds, then spend 2 Emeralds to roll.
item.restrictions: The Enchant Table is absent in SkyWars, Gun Game, Infected, Lasso Wars, Block Hunt, Arena Duels, and One in the Chamber.
